# Feetify

> Feetify (thefeetify.com) is an 18+ landing page about selling feet pics on Feetify, a dedicated foot-content marketplace that has been paying sellers since 2019. The page covers anonymous profiles, secure in-platform payments, seller-set pricing, what content sells best, and how Feetify compares to general creator platforms and social media messages. All calls to action link to FeetFinder via an affiliate link. Feetify is an independent service, is not affiliated with FeetFinder, and earns affiliate commissions from referral links.
